# CLI reference

Run `pcbtestkit <command> --help` for the same text. Without a pip install use `python3 -m pcbtestkit` with the repository (or the installed plugin folder) on `PYTHONPATH`. AI agents: start with `pcbtestkit guide`.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `run` | full export |
| `analyze` | weak-point analysis only |
| `init` | write a pcbtestkit.json template next to the project |
| `api` | call one agent-API tool |
| `tools` | list agent tools (--brief) or export their definitions |
| `guide` | print the agent quick reference (cheapest way for an AI to use this CLI) |
| `classes` | technology-class systems: list, show, check a board, validate, template |
| `facilities` | test facilities (your tester: connector, buses, driver): list, show, validate, template |
| `station` | several board types on one test station: plan the batch of each, or run them all |
| `mcp` | run the MCP stdio server |

## `pcbtestkit run`

full export

```text
pcbtestkit run [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--probe-side {auto,bottom,top}]
                      [--fab {standard,advanced,conservative}] [--class-system CLASS_SYSTEM]
                      [--tech-class TECH_CLASS] [--check-class SYSTEM[:CLASS]] [--no-kicad]
                      [--json] [--out OUT] [--panel PANEL] [--batch BATCH] [--facility FACILITY]
                      [--program-connector {same,swd10,jtag20,avr_isp6,pic_icsp6,pins}]
                      [--outline {rect,outline}] [--jig-parts JIG_PARTS] [--no-fixture]
                      [--no-route] [--no-jig] [--no-runner] [--no-visuals] [--video]
                      [--video-fps VIDEO_FPS] [--video-stills]
                      [--video-quality {basic,standard,best,high}] [--background] [-q]
                      project
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `project` | .kicad_pcb, .kicad_pro or project folder |
| `--config` | alternative pcbtestkit.json |
| `--probe-side` | (one of: auto, bottom, top) |
| `--fab` | (one of: standard, advanced, conservative) |
| `--class-system` | class system id (pcbtestkit classes list), default eurocircuits-2024 |
| `--tech-class` | class to order in that system, e.g. 6C, standard, 4-layer |
| `--check-class` | extra class check, repeatable, e.g. ipc-2221-voltage:B2 |
| `--no-kicad` | skip kicad-cli DRC/ERC |
| `--json` |  |
| `--out` | output folder (default <project>/production_test) |
| `--panel` | fixture sites, e.g. 2x2 |
| `--batch` | boards per batch: one fixture site per board, jigs that hold them all |
| `--facility` | test facility the fixture plugs into (pcbtestkit facilities list), default raspberry-pi |
| `--program-connector` | programming connector per board on the fixture (default: a copy of the board's header) (one of: same, swd10, jtag20, avr_isp6, pic_icsp6, pins) |
| `--outline` | (one of: rect, outline) |
| `--jig-parts` | comma separated refs (default: all THT) |
| `--no-fixture` |  |
| `--no-route` | leave the fixture board unrouted (ratsnest only) |
| `--no-jig` |  |
| `--no-runner` |  |
| `--no-visuals` | skip the KiCad 3D renders in the guide |
| `--video` | also render the explainer video: real 3D animation rendered with KiCad (needs ffmpeg; several minutes) |
| `--video-fps` | frame rate of the video's motion shots (default 24) |
| `--video-stills` | quick video from stills only, without the 3D animation |
| `--video-quality` | ray tracing of the motion shots (default standard: shadows and ambient occlusion) (one of: basic, standard, best, high) |
| `--background` | with --video: make everything else now and render the video in a background job (progress window) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` |  |

## `pcbtestkit analyze`

weak-point analysis only

```text
pcbtestkit analyze [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--probe-side {auto,bottom,top}]
                          [--fab {standard,advanced,conservative}] [--class-system CLASS_SYSTEM]
                          [--tech-class TECH_CLASS] [--check-class SYSTEM[:CLASS]] [--no-kicad]
                          [--json] [--strict]
                          project
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `project` | .kicad_pcb, .kicad_pro or project folder |
| `--config` | alternative pcbtestkit.json |
| `--probe-side` | (one of: auto, bottom, top) |
| `--fab` | (one of: standard, advanced, conservative) |
| `--class-system` | class system id (pcbtestkit classes list), default eurocircuits-2024 |
| `--tech-class` | class to order in that system, e.g. 6C, standard, 4-layer |
| `--check-class` | extra class check, repeatable, e.g. ipc-2221-voltage:B2 |
| `--no-kicad` | skip kicad-cli DRC/ERC |
| `--json` |  |
| `--strict` | exit 1 on critical findings (CI) |

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tool` |  |
| `--project` |  |

## `pcbtestkit tools`

list agent tools (--brief) or export their definitions

```text
pcbtestkit tools [-h] [--format {mcp,anthropic,openai}] [--read-only]
                        [--profile {full,core,readonly}] [--brief] [--name NAME]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--format` | (one of: mcp, anthropic, openai; default: mcp) |
| `--read-only` |  |
| `--profile` | (one of: full, core, readonly; default: full) |
| `--brief` | one line per tool: name, R/W, summary |
| `--name` | print one tool's description and input schema |

## `pcbtestkit classes`

technology-class systems: list, show, check a board, validate, template

```text
pcbtestkit classes [-h] [--class CLS] [--system SYSTEM] [--target TARGET_CLASS]
                          [--config CONFIG] [--out OUT] [--json]
                          {list,show,check,validate,template,catalog} [target ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | (one of: list, show, check, validate, template, catalog) |
| `target` | system id (show), project (check) or JSON files (validate) |
| `--class` | class to show (show) |
| `--system` | limit check to these systems (check) |
| `--target` | check compliance with this class of one --system (check) |
| `--config` | alternative pcbtestkit.json (check) |
| `--out` | output file (template) |
| `--json` |  |

## `pcbtestkit facilities`

test facilities (your tester: connector, buses, driver): list, show, validate, template

```text
pcbtestkit facilities [-h] [--out OUT] [--connector CONNECTOR] [--id ID]
                             [--analog-max-v ANALOG_MAX_V] [--json]
                             {list,show,validate,template,from-pcb} [target ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | (one of: list, show, validate, template, from-pcb) |
| `target` | facility id (show), facility.json files (validate) or the station's .kicad_pcb (from-pcb) |
| `--out` | folder to write facility.json (and driver.py for template) to; from-pcb also takes a .json file |
| `--connector` | from-pcb: reference of the station's interface connector (default: found from its nets) |
| `--id` | from-pcb: facility id (default: from the board's file name) |
| `--analog-max-v` | from-pcb: full-scale voltage of the station's analog inputs |
| `--json` |  |

## `pcbtestkit station`

several board types on one test station: plan the batch of each, or run them all

```text
pcbtestkit station [-h] [--out OUT] [--batch BOARD=N] [--connector CONNECTOR]
                          [--analog-max-v ANALOG_MAX_V] [--max-sites MAX_SITES] [--no-visuals]
                          [--no-route] [--video [{all,station,boards}]] [-q] [--json]
                          {plan,run} station projects [projects ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | (one of: plan, run) |
| `station` | the station: its .kicad_pcb (interface connector nets AIN1.., VOUT1.., CAN1_H, ...), a facility.json or an installed facility id |
| `projects` | the boards: .kicad_pcb, .kicad_pro or project folders |
| `--out` | run: output folder (default station_out): <board>/ per board, station.html, station.json |
| `--batch` | boards per fixture for one board type (default: as many as the station's inputs, supplies, buses and plate allow); repeatable |
| `--connector` | reference of the station's interface connector (default: found from its nets) |
| `--analog-max-v` | full-scale voltage of the station's analog inputs |
| `--max-sites` | at most this many boards per fixture |
| `--no-visuals` | run: skip the KiCad 3D renders in the guides |
| `--no-route` | run: leave the fixture boards unrouted (faster) |
| `--video` | run: render videos (KiCad 3D animation; minutes per video): all = the station video and every board's explainer, station = only the station video, boards = only the boards' (one of: all, station, boards) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` |  |
| `--json` |  |

## `pcbtestkit mcp`

run the MCP stdio server

```text
pcbtestkit mcp [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--read-only] [--profile {full,core,readonly}]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--project` | board or project to open at start (open_project can switch later) |
| `--read-only` | refuse every write tool |
| `--profile` | tools to expose: full (34), core (16, about half the tokens), readonly (one of: full, core, readonly; default: full) |
